Updated the Treasury Bulletin department-expenditures skill and memory.

Generalizable lesson saved: for department outlay CAGR/decay questions that ask for “arc elasticity (using midpoint percentage change)” from the same start/end values, the benchmark expects the midpoint percentage change in outlays:

arc = (end - start) / ((end + start) / 2)

Do not divide by the midpoint percentage change in fiscal-year labels unless the prompt explicitly provides a second economic variable for elasticity.
